info.title: Polymarket WebSocket API — Sports Channel
info.description:
Public WebSocket channel for real-time sports results. No authentication or subscription required — connect and receive live match updates for all active sports events.

!! DIVERGENCE: this document mirrors https://docs.polymarket.com/api-reference/wss/sports.md faithfully, and that upstream page does not describe what the server actually sends. Both the payload schema and the keep-alive below are wrong on the wire. See x-observed-payload and x-observed-keepalive for what 229 frames captured on 2026-07-25 actually contained, and prefer those when writing a client. polyoxide's SportsUpdateMessage is modelled on the observed shape, not on SportResult.

x-observed-keepalive.finding: The server sends WebSocket protocol-level PING control frames (opcode 0x9), which conforming client libraries answer automatically. It does NOT send a text frame containing 'ping', and no text 'pong' reply is required. Over a 5-minute capture: 20 protocol PINGs (~1 per 15s), 0 text ping frames.
x-observed-keepalive.contradicts: components.messages.ping / components.messages.pong, which document text/plain 'ping' and 'pong' every 5s with a 10s timeout.

x-observed-payload.sampleSize: 229 frames over 5 minutes, covering soccer, tennis, cricket, and the lol/val/cs2/dota2/mlbb esports titles
x-observed-payload.finding: No frame contained a 'slug' field, and none contained 'last_update' or 'turn'. The real payload is keyed on 'leagueAbbreviation' plus either 'gameId' (numeric) or, for cricket, 'metadataGameId' (string). Frames carry no event discriminator of any kind.

optionalObserved.gameId: integer; present on 222/229 frames, absent on cricket
optionalObserved.metadataGameId: string; cricket's identifier, mutually exclusive with gameId
optionalObserved.status: string; casing is not normalised upstream ('InProgress', 'inprogress', 'running')
optionalObserved.finishedTimestamp: ISO 8601; only once ended is true
optionalObserved.eventState: object; nested per-sport detail whose shape varies (tennis adds tournamentName and tennisRound)

sports.title: Sports Channel
sports.description: Public channel broadcasting live sports results. No subscription message required — connect and immediately start receiving updates for all active events. The server sends a ping every 5 seconds; respond with pong within 10 seconds to stay connected.

ping.title: Ping
ping.summary: Server sends ping every 5 seconds — respond with pong within 10 seconds

receiveSportsUpdate.title: Sports Update
receiveSportsUpdate.summary: Live match update broadcast to all connected clients
receiveSportsUpdate.description: Emitted whenever a live match has an update — score change, period change, match started or ended. Supports NFL, soccer, NBA, MLB, NHL, and cricket.

pong.name: Pong
pong.title: Pong
pong.summary: Client heartbeat response — must be sent within 10 seconds

SportResult.description: Real-time sports match update. Only slug is required; all other fields may be omitted if not applicable.

live.description: Whether the match is currently in progress

score.description: Current score (e.g., '2-1' for soccer, '14-7' for football)

period.description: Current period. Soccer: '1H', '2H', 'HT', 'FT', 'PEN'. NFL: 'Q1'–'Q4', 'HT', 'OT', 'FT'. NBA/CBB: 'Q1'–'Q4', 'HT', 'OT', 'FT'. MLB: 'Top 1st', 'Bot 1st', ... Ice Hockey: 'P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'OT', 'PEN', 'FT'. Cricket: '1H', '1A', '2H', '2A', 'SO', 'FT'. Other: 'CAN', 'POST', 'INT', 'AB'.

elapsed.description: Elapsed time in the current period in 'MM:SS' format. Empty string if not applicable.

last_update.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update

finished_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the match ended. Only present for ended matches.

turn.description: Team abbreviation with ball possession. NFL only.
